source_tokens.text: "CLAIM-002 (source: AcadeResearch 9-company AI margin cross-section, 2026-08-16): Uber's general and administrative plus research and development expense as a percentage of revenue will decline by at least 1 percentage point by end of 2026 if AI coding-tool adoption is actually compressing corporate overhead. Falsifier: Uber G&A plus R&D combined remain at or above 14% of revenue at 4Q26"
